description: For \(j<N\) and a clean step realizer, the actual recursion body, after the controller consumes one countdown unit from the specified \(j\)-boundary, returns exactly the \((j+1)\)-boundary for a defined value \(h(\bar x,j,a)\downarrow=b\). It uses the old index \(j\), restores its inputs, replaces the previous value and clears the next-value port.
